note: Source files whose strings are not the interface's words, by reason (milestone 59; tests/i18n.test.ts, docs/translating.md). Anything else the window or the menus show is in src/locales/.

src/core/capture-format.ts.why: The capture probe's page and its measurement.

src/core/cli.ts.why: The command line's help, usage errors and grammar: read in a shell and parsed by scripts.

src/core/edit-export.ts.why: FCPXML and EDL written for an editing app.

src/core/fonts.ts.why: The bundled fonts' provenance and credits: versions, archives and licenses, as their publishers give them.

src/core/log.ts.why: The diagnostics report and the log: pasted into bug reports, read by maintainers.

src/core/lottie-page.ts.why: The page a Lottie animation is drawn in.

src/core/lottie-starter.ts.why: The words of a generated starter template: what the template says, not the window.

src/core/media-serve.ts.why: HTTP headers for the media protocol.

src/core/panel-bridge.ts.why: The editor panel bridge's HTTP answers: an API's words; the panels in panels/ have their own interface.

src/core/perf.ts.why: Performance lines for Copy Diagnostics: pasted into bug reports, read by maintainers.

src/core/release.ts.why: The release script's checks, run by the maintainer from a shell.

src/core/render-guard.ts.why: Script run inside a template page to catch its errors.

src/core/runtime.ts.why: The bridge script and the content security policy injected into template pages.

src/core/sample-asset-effects.ts.why: JavaScript spliced into the sample asset page's script: drawing code, not words.

src/core/sample-asset-objects-more.ts.why: JavaScript spliced into the sample asset page's script: drawing code, not words.

src/core/sample-asset-objects.ts.why: JavaScript spliced into the sample asset page's script: drawing code, not words.

src/core/sample-asset-ten.ts.why: JavaScript spliced into the sample asset page's script: drawing code, not words.

src/core/sample-media.ts.why: The sample-media catalog: generated files' folders (paths on disk), names and notes, library content like a template's description.

src/core/sample-stills.ts.why: Words drawn into generated sample stills, part of the picture.

src/core/subtitles.ts.why: SRT and WebVTT written from the captions: the words are the person's own.

src/main/protocol.ts.why: MIME types and HTTP answers for the app's protocols.

src/main/visual-service.ts.why: The visual-hash and safe-box checks, run from the command line and the test suite.
